title: DTJ Wave Divider

settings.label: Wave color
settings.info: The color BELOW the wave: use the color of the section that follows. Nothing shows until you pick one. The color above the wave is the background color below.

options.label: Layered waves (see-through copies that drift past each other)

settings.label: Waves across the screen
settings.info: More waves = a tighter ripple. Layered copies use a slightly different count each, which makes them cross.

settings.label: How deep the wave is
settings.info: The height of the crests and troughs as a share of the band.

settings.label: Turn upside down
settings.info: Puts the wave color above and the background color below.

settings.label: Pull up over the section above
settings.info: Tucks the band under the section above so no thin line shows between them.

settings.label: Waves drift sideways
settings.info: Stands still for visitors who ask their device for less motion.
